lines: Zindagi jab bhi teri bazm mein laati hai humein
couplets.en: Whenever life brings me into your company.

lines: Yeh zameen chaand se behtar nazar aati hai humein
couplets.en: This earth seems lovelier than the moon.

lines: Surkh phoolon se mahak uthti hain dil ki raahein
couplets.en: Red flowers fill the paths of the heart with fragrance.

lines: Din dhale yoon teri aawaaz bulaati hai humein
couplets.en: As daylight fades, this is how your voice calls to me.

lines: Yeh zameen chaand se behtar nazar aati hai humein
couplets.en: This earth seems lovelier than the moon.

lines: Yaad teri kabhi dastak, kabhi sargoshi se
couplets.en: The thought of you comes sometimes as a knock, sometimes as a whisper.

lines: Raat ke pichhle pahar roz jagaati hai humein
couplets.en: It wakes me every night in the hours before dawn.

lines: Yeh zameen chaand se behtar nazar aati hai humein
couplets.en: This earth seems lovelier than the moon.

lines: Har mulaaqaat ka anjaam judaai kyoon hai
couplets.en: Why must every meeting end in parting?

lines: Ab to har waqt yahi baat sataati hai humein
couplets.en: Now that question gives me no rest.
